description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)” on the x-axis and two performance metrics on the dual y-axes: “Perplexity” (left, linear scale from 4.2 to 4.7) and “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)” (right, linear scale from 40 to 100). Four distinct lines are plotted: an orange solid line with circle markers representing “Perplexity” starts at approximately 4.6 at 10% sequence ratio, drops sharply to ~4.3 at 40%, then fluctuates slightly before rising to ~4.4 at 100%; a red dashed line labeled “Full Cache PPL” remains flat at ~4.38 across all sequence ratios; a blue solid line with circle markers labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio” begins near 42% at 10%, rises gradually to ~50% at 80%, then jumps steeply to ~99% at 100%; and a blue dashed line labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.” stays constant at 100% across the entire x-axis. The plot uses a grid background and includes a legend in the upper left corner to distinguish the lines.
